run_ehull_correction_cli: run the CLI to compute energy above hull for DFT-relaxed structures and write results to JSON
get_dft_results_from_trajectories: get a DataFrame of DFT results by parsing .traj files from a clean_outputs directory
get_energy_correction_for_trajectory: get the corrected energy and phase diagram entry for a trajectory using MaterialsProject2020Compatibility
get_e_hull_from_phase_diagram: get the energy above hull per atom for a structure composition using a Materials Project phase diagram
get_compat_params_from_vasp: get Hubbard U parameters and run type from VASP INCAR and POSCAR files in a DFT directory
